visualStyleNotes: Data And Statistics, Math palette, Anatomy Atelier bar: warm off-white/paper background (#F7F3EC) with soft radial vignette, no floor grid, no props. A horizontal track 0-100 with value blocks, a double-headed range arrow, and a slider/anchor interaction. Soft neutral studio light, no rim-light glow, no bloom, no emissive. Strong saturated color reserved for the small flat hotspot dots (amber / molecular-green / slate-blue from the palette). Specimen-quality clean-3D, not cartoon, not cluttered.
materialNotes: Metallic-roughness PBR, metallic=0 everywhere. Track: soft warm-grey rail with ink ticks (roughness ~0.5). Value blocks: warm paper cubes with ink numbers. Range arrow: double-headed strip warm amber. Outlier: one gray block slightly offset. Length label: warm paper plate with live range value. Mat: soft warm-grey (roughness ~0.85). No emissive channels — highlights handled by app runtime UI.
assetBrief:
SUBJECT: range as the min-to-max spread — a track with blocks (55, 70, 82, 90, plus extremes); a double-headed arrow spans the gap; dragging extremes updates the label; outlier adds a far block and widens the page.

GEOMETRY: A horizontal track marked 0-100 with a series of value blocks sitting on it at their values (55, 70, 82, 90). The low (55) and high (90) ends are highlighted; a double-headed arrow with a center label spans from low to high showing the range. Sliding a block moves it along the track and updates the range label. 'Bunched' preset clusters blocks; 'outlier' adds a gray fifth block at 5 that snaps the arrow wide.

LAYERS (toggleable): (1) track; (2) value blocks; (3) range arrow + label; (4) outlier block.

CAMERA: three-quarter from front-left, above, frames the full track; labels visible. Budget 5-9k triangles. Named nodes: Track, Blocks, LowBlock, HighBlock, RangeArrow, RangeLabel, OutlierBlock. All labels are hotspot dots in the app layer.
